question: What do cost elements primarily measure in healthcare delivery?

options.B: Government tax deductions for private clinics
options.C: Total profit generated by a hospital ward

explanation: Cost elements serve as the fundamental building blocks used to measure the various resources utilized while providing patient care. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h1)

question: Why is cost awareness particularly critical for healthcare facilities in Nigeria?

options.A: Resource scarcity makes proper fund utilization essential
options.B: Staff salaries are completely uniform across all states
options.C: Private hospitals dictate national healthcare budgets
options.D: Foreign donors cover all operational expenditures

explanation: Limited resources in many settings require careful tracking of expenditures to prevent supply shortages and maintain effective care. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h1)

question: Which expense is classified as a direct cost in patient care?

options.A: Administrative salaries for the billing department
options.B: Surgical sutures used for a specific patient
options.C: General electricity bill for the entire hospital
options.D: Routine maintenance of the facility lawn

explanation: Direct costs are expenses that link directly and exclusively to the care of a specific patient or procedure. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h2)

question: A patient receives a course of intravenous antibiotics. How is this expense categorized?
explanation: Medications given to a specific individual represent an expense that is easily traced to that patient's care. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h2)

question: What is another common term used for indirect costs in healthcare management?
explanation: Indirect costs are commonly known as overhead because they support overall facility operations rather than individual treatments. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h3)

question: What represents a productivity loss from a societal perspective during illness?

options.A: Depreciation value of a newly purchased hospital ambulance
options.B: Electricity bills paid by the hospital administration
options.C: Wages lost when a relative misses work to care for a patient
options.D: The cost of diagnostic lab reagents purchased by the pharmacy

explanation: Productivity losses measure the economic value of work time lost by patients or their caregivers due to illness. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h3)

question: Which of the following is an example of a fixed cost in a clinic?
explanation: Fixed costs like rent do not change when patient volume fluctuates up or down. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h4)

question: How do variable costs behave when patient admissions increase significantly in a ward?

options.A: They convert automatically into capital depreciation
options.B: They increase in proportion to the patient volume
options.C: They remain completely unchanged throughout the month
options.D: They drop to zero due to bulk purchasing discounts

explanation: Variable costs rise and fall directly with the number of patients utilizing clinical supplies and services. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h4)

question: What characterizes a capital cost in a healthcare facility?

options.A: Daily purchase of gauze and disposable syringes
options.B: Monthly payment for municipal water supply
options.C: Immediate settlement of routine cleaning wages
options.D: Investment in long-term assets like heavy machinery

explanation: Capital costs involve expensive, long-lasting assets that provide utility over many years rather than immediate consumption. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h5)

question: What is the primary risk of purchasing expensive capital equipment without planning for operational expenses?

options.A: Nursing salaries will be converted into variable wages
options.B: Patient admission numbers will immediately drop to zero
options.C: The building rent will automatically increase threefold
options.D: The equipment may sit idle due to a lack of maintenance funds

explanation: Operational funds are required to service and run machinery; lacking them leaves valuable equipment unusable. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h5)

question: What does opportunity cost represent in healthcare decision making?

options.A: The total financial profit made from patient fees
options.B: The direct cost of purchasing surgical gloves
options.C: The value of the next best alternative given up
options.D: The depreciation value of a hospital building

explanation: Opportunity cost is defined as the benefit sacrificed when choosing one alternative over another. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h6)

question: A clinic spends its entire grant on a new laboratory microscope, missing out on funding a maternal health workshop. What does the workshop represent?

options.A: A capital depreciation charge for the clinic
options.B: A direct variable cost of laboratory testing
options.C: The opportunity cost of the microscope purchase
options.D: An overhead expense for facility maintenance

explanation: The forgone workshop represents the alternative benefit sacrificed to acquire the microscope. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h6)

question: A nurse manager monitors supply expiration dates to prevent wastage on the ward. Which cost category is being managed?
explanation: Medical supplies used directly in patient care form part of the direct cost category which is managed by preventing waste. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h7)

question: How does understanding cost elements assist a nurse unit manager in administrative duties?

options.A: It eliminates all variable expenses within the clinical ward
options.B: It allows the nurse to bypass hospital procurement protocols
options.C: It improves participation in budget planning and resource advocacy
options.D: It guarantees automatic salary increases for subordinate staff

explanation: Grasping financial concepts empowers nurses to justify their unit needs and contribute meaningfully to institutional budgeting. [learn more](GST322_U2_T2#GST322_U2_T2_h7)
